dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: That's right — specifically, from Yashiori Island!

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Over there... Well, hehe, I just couldn't stay. That's why I came to Nod-Krai. It's a foreign land, but at least it's a safe one for now.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: But of course, if I need to leave here, that's fine too...
